description: Data-center records of the Atlas of Data Center Politics that have a town point, counted by place: one row for each of the 2,303 towns and U.S. Census places at which the project placed at least one record of dc_atlas_points. A place is a town, not a site. Its records may be separate sites kilometers apart, and the Atlas table does not say how they relate. Each row counts the records of the place by Atlas status, size class and operator-type group, and for a place with one record it also gives that record's size class and group. The counts are made from the records of abf-dc 0.1.0, which this version publishes unchanged. The 3,778 records without a town point are not in this layer.

fields.description: Identifier set by the project: PLC- and the place_ref of the place, with the colon replaced by a hyphen.

fields.name: place_ref

fields.name: place_name

fields.description: Latitude of the place (WGS 84), as in dc_atlas_points.

fields.name: coord_precision

fields.name: iso3_source

coverage.geography: Places of the 126 countries and territories listed in the Atlas national tables
known_gaps: A place is a town point, not a site. 4,663 records share their place with at least one other record, and 109 places hold 10 or more records each (Shanghai 80, Beijing 70, Ashburn 57). The records of one place may be separate sites, buildings or phases of one site, or repeats.

3,778 of the 9,865 Atlas records are not in this layer: 1,583 U.S. records placed only in a county, which are counted in dc_atlas_count_usa_adm2, and 2,195 records without a place below the country, which are counted only by country (dc_atlas_count_adm0).

The town of each record comes from its address or its name, by the rules described in dc_atlas_points. 1,686 of the 6,087 records with a point take their town from the record name; in a test this rule gave the same town as the address in 86.9% of cases.
Counts follow the Atlas rows: records identical in every field are counted separately.
The size class is the Atlas's own, and the Atlas does not state whether it refers to IT power or to the whole facility. 296 of the 1,424 places with one record have the class Unknown.

The points of four places in border towns (Gibraltar, Sittard, Grevenmacher, Lauterbourg) fall in the neighboring country on the generalized 1:10 million outlines, so iso3_frame differs from iso3_source. One place, Simferopol, lies in Crimea, which abf-boundaries v0.2.0 shows under Russian control and records as claimed by Ukraine (control_iso3). Neither is a position of the project.

The operator type is the Atlas's type of the operator of a record, not the use of the site; we found no definition of the types on the Atlas pages we read. The groups are the project's (operator_type_groups.csv). The Atlas type AI Compute does not mark AI data centers as Epoch AI does: the 63 Epoch AI sites found in the Atlas match 75 Atlas records, of which 39 have the type Cloud, 24 Colocation and 10 AI Compute.

verification.method: Places are counted by script from the published records of dc_atlas_points (abf-dc 0.1.0); a place is the place_ref of a record. The build stops if the records of one place differ in point, name or country, if the places do not add up to the 6,087 records with a town point, or if the counts by status, by size class or by operator-type group in a row do not add up to n_records. No new check by an agent was made: the layer only counts records whose places were set by rules and checked by sample in abf-dc 0.1.0, as described in dc_atlas_points.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
record_id is present and unique in all 2,303 records.
Records with coord_precision  have no coordinates; every other record has a longitude and a latitude in range.
Every value of iso3_source, iso3_frame, control_iso3 is the ISO 3166 alpha-3 code of a country or territory of the boundaries release.
The fields coord_precision, power_class, type_group hold only the values listed in their descriptions.

Recomputed from the published file and equal to the numbers in the texts of this layer: the number of records (2,303); the counts by coord_precision, type_group; the totals of n_records, n_type_colocation, n_type_telecom, n_type_developer_investor, n_type_cloud, n_type_enterprise_it, n_type_ai_compute, n_type_other.
Every record has a non-empty ref (reference to the source record).
Power fields of the layer (power_class) are on the ADR 6.2 list; the layer gives a size class, not megawatts, and each record has one power basis.
